title: CONSIDER: A. DEOBLIGATING $2.23 million of previously approved Call for Projects (Call) funding, as shown in Attachment A, and held in reserve; B. APPROVING…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0585, Program]
[PLANNING AND PROGRAMMING COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (4-0):]
CONSIDER:

A.	DEOBLIGATING $2.23 million of previously approved Call for Projects (Call) funding, as shown in Attachment A, and held in reserve;

B.	APPROVING changes to the scope of work for the City of Long Beach - 1st Street Pedestrian Gallery (#F9628); 

C.	AUTHORIZING the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) or their designee to negotiate and execute all necessary agreements/or amendments for previously awarded projects; and

D.	RECEIVING AND FILING time extensions for 46 projects shown in Attachment B.
summary: Deobligates $2.23 million in previously approved funding, approves scope changes for Long Beach 1st Street Pedestrian Gallery project, and receives time extensions for 46 projects.
